spec.moment: A calm, quiet windowsill at night with warm tea and a glowing lamp.

elements.name: ceramic mug
elements.look: A warm speckled ceramic mug with a faint curl of steam rising from it.

elements.name: potted houseplant
elements.look: A round clay pot holding a leafy green plant with rounded drooping leaves.

spec.scene: A thick wooden windowsill spans the center. In the middle rests a warm speckled ceramic mug, beside a small rounded lamp radiating a soft amber light across the sill. To the left sits a leafy green houseplant in a small terracotta pot, its leaves gently drooping in the quiet evening. At the back edge rises a single dark windowpane reflecting the warm yellow glow of the tiny lamp.
spec.title: A Quiet Night
spec.caption: Just taking in the silence and winding down for the night.
